role_semantics: MTG-specific definitions in data; shared candidate subject, evidence, value states, review and supersession are game-neutral.

card_draw.definition: Provide an explicitly stated draw outcome.
evidence_requirements: Include draw quantity, beneficiary, conditional instructions and accompanying discard/return; drawing is not automatically positive net advantage.
card_draw.label: Card draw

card_selection.definition: Choose, filter or reorder accessible cards.
evidence_requirements: Require explicit look/choice/order evidence, or mark strategic filtering from draw/discard as contextual and incomplete.
card_selection.label: Card selection

combo_enabling.definition: Identify a contextual component for future interaction investigation.
evidence_requirements: Require direct resource/permission evidence and explicit missing partner/cost/sequence dependencies; no verified combo, infinite loop, positive net resource or strength claim is admitted.
combo_enabling.label: Potential combo enabling (review only)

event_payoff.definition: Produce an explicitly stated benefit on a specified event.
evidence_requirements: Include event, subject/controller, other/self distinction and recipient; a death payoff is not necessarily sacrifice-specific.
event_payoff.label: Event payoff

mana_acceleration.definition: Create action-paying resources or access to additional resources.
evidence_requirements: Require the actual production/access outcome and its costs, recipients, conditions and resource restrictions; an untap or resource word alone is insufficient.
mana_acceleration.label: Resource acceleration

protection.definition: Provide a stated prevention, targeting restriction or protective permission.
evidence_requirements: Identify protected subjects, scope and duration; interpreting interaction as protection requires a separately stated threat/objective.
protection.label: Protection

recursion.definition: Restore access to a previously used or discarded card/object.
evidence_requirements: Preserve source and destination or casting permission, owner, permitted object class, costs, timing and exclusions; library-top return is not draw.
recursion.label: Recursion/access restoration

removal.definition: Remove a specified game object through an explicit effect.
evidence_requirements: Identify action, permitted target, destination, compensation and restrictions; removal keywords or death references alone are insufficient.
removal.label: Removal

sacrifice_outlet.definition: Provide a controllable activation with an explicit sacrifice cost.
evidence_requirements: Identify the sacrificing ability, permitted object and benefit; forced sacrifice, death payoffs and a created token's self-sacrifice do not establish a creature outlet on its creator.
sacrifice_outlet.label: Voluntary sacrifice outlet

stack_interaction.definition: Alter or prevent a pending action.
evidence_requirements: Identify the exact affected action and restrictions; MTG counter-a-spell does not imply counter-an-ability or removing a resolved permanent.
stack_interaction.label: Pending-action interaction

tutoring.definition: Search for a permitted card or object.
evidence_requirements: Include searched location, allowed selection, destination, costs, timing and resulting control or other downside.
tutoring.label: Tutoring

scope: Eleven provisional role definitions for this reviewed pilot; not an exhaustive or universally approved taxonomy.
